title: Where each platform's claims arrive and are logged
keywords: claims file shopee claims tracking lazada xspace tokgistic top up internal claims
body: Shopee: arrives by email → Shopee Claims Tracking file.
Lazada: arrives via the Xspace portal → update the Lazada Claims portal; liable cases in the Top up / Internal Claims file.
TikTok: arrives as a Tokgistic ticket → Top up / Internal Claims file.
